::: {#research .panel role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="t-research"}
[Research]{.panel-title}

My work is on **Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks**, a neural network architecture
that places learnable activation functions on edges instead of fixed ones on
nodes. I focus on three questions:

::: {.topics}
::: {.topic}
[01]{.num}

**Training them well.** Adaptive optimizer sequencing (L-BFGS first), tested
with ablations against baselines.
:::

::: {.topic}
[02]{.num}

**Reading them.** Turning trained KANs into mathematical formulas (Julia), so
the model can be inspected.
:::

::: {.topic}
[03]{.num}

**Knowing when they're wrong.** Estimating confidence and expected error,
including Hessian-based analysis.
:::
:::
:::
